class.name: NetwSceneHandle
class.brief_description: The scene an entity belongs to, reached as [member NetwEntity.scene].
class.description: Tells who is in a multiplayer scene and which players it replicates to. Reach it with [method Netw.scene] or [member NetwEntity.scene]. An entity declared with [method Netw.configure_multiplayer_scene] resolves to itself, any other entity to its closest scene ancestor. Each scene has one handle, so [code]==[/code] compares scenes. A scene replicates to a player while a body of theirs is in it, or while the player watches it with [method watch]. [method unwatch] does not remove a player whose body is still in the scene. [codeblock] lobby.watch(player) arena.add_child(Netw.spawn_player(player, make_player)) lobby.unwatch(player) [/codeblock] Inside a scene, [NetwInterestLayer] still filters which entities a player receives. A body is moved with [method Node.reparent] as you would normally do. Use [method Netw.reparent] when you need to await the server taking the move.

method.name: is_watching
method.description: Whether this scene replicates to [param player], either because a body of theirs is in it or because of [method watch].

method.name: observe
method.description:
Calls [param callback] whenever this scene gains or loses a subject of [param event]. Registering the same [param callback] twice does nothing. [codeblock] arena.observe(NetwMultiplayer.SCENE_EVENT_BODY, on_car_edge)
func on_car_edge(present: bool, car: NetwEntity) -> bool: reshuffle(car) return false # true drops the subscription [/codeblock] [constant NetwMultiplayer.SCENE_EVENT_VIEWER] passes a [NetwPlayer]. [constant NetwMultiplayer.SCENE_EVENT_BODY] and [constant NetwMultiplayer.SCENE_EVENT_ENTITY] pass a [NetwEntity].

method.name: unobserve
method.description: Removes a [param callback] registered with [method observe]. It must be the same [Callable] that was passed to [method observe].

method.name: unwatch
method.description: Undoes [method watch]. The scene keeps replicating to [param player] while a body of theirs is in it. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the watch is withdrawn ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER a null player, or one this session no longer holds ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST this player was not watching [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: watch
method.description: Replicates this scene to [param player] without giving them a body in it, such as for a lobby or a spectator. A player can watch several scenes at once. [codeblock] Netw.scene(lobby).watch(who) [/codeblock] Watching a nested scene also sends the scene roots above it, but not their content. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the watch stands ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER a null player, or one this session no longer holds ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST this scene names no live node [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

members.member: Every body in this scene, in no particular order. A body is removed as soon as it is despawned, before its node is freed.
The [RID] of the scene's entity, invalid outside a session. The [code]scene_*[/code] methods of [NetwMultiplayer] take it.
Whether a scene was found. [code]false[/code] for an entity outside every scene or not in the tree, and every other member is empty.
The name [method Netw.scene] finds this scene by. See [method NetwSceneConfig.labeled].
Every body in this scene that belongs to this peer.

The node the scene was declared on, [code]null[/code] outside a session. When the scene is [method NetwSceneConfig.isolated], [method Netw.spawn] returns [member world] and this is the node inside it.
Every player this scene replicates to, see [method is_watching].
The [SubViewport] above [member root] that gives an [method NetwSceneConfig.isolated] scene its own [World2D] and [World3D], [code]null[/code] otherwise.

signal.name: body_entered
signal.description: Emitted when [param body] enters this scene.

signal.name: body_left
signal.description: Emitted when [param body] leaves this scene.

signal.name: viewer_entered
signal.description: Emitted when this scene starts replicating to [param player]. [member viewers] already includes them. To spawn players, use [signal NetwSessionHandle.scene_changed] instead.

signal.name: viewer_left
signal.description: Emitted when this scene stops replicating to [param player].
